flora: Cretaceous Conifers (tall, stately trunks, dense clusters of short, flattened needles)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; avoid sharp, hyper-realistic pine needles; render foliage as dense, rounded 'pillows' or tufts of dark green with soft-touch volume; sturdy, prominent trunks with deeply grooved but rounded bark plates.

visual_logic.composition: A dramatic low-angle view looking up past a massive conifer trunk toward its tiered, rounded foliage clusters that rise high into a bright sky.
visual_logic.ground: A thick, soft carpet of rusty ochre fallen needles and woody detritus around the flared base of the tree trunk.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; strong directional side-lighting that emphasizes the blocky, 3D volume of the bark texture and the layers of the canopy.
